ledger.x: 839: Amalfi frees itself from Lombard rule and elects a prefect.
981: Amalfi takes the rule of the Principality of Salerno.
1034: Amalfi comes under the Principality of Capua.
1039: Capua's hold ends as Amalfi passes to Salerno.
1039: Amalfi comes under the Principality of Salerno.
1073: the Salernitan control is taken to end here, by the next dated event; page silent on when it ended.
1096: Amalfi revolts against the Normans and sets up its own doge.
1101: the Norman lords put down the Amalfi revolt.
1130: Amalfi revolts again against the Normans.
1131: Roger II subdues Amalfi and its independence ends.

wars.name: Sorrento's defeat of Amalfi
wars.outcome: Sorrento, supported by Naples, defeated Amalfi in 897; the prefect was captured and later ransomed.

wars.name: Norman conquest of Amalfi
wars.outcome: Robert Guiscard conquered the city in 1073 and took the title dux Amalfitanorum; Amalfi 'was granted many rights'.

wars.name: Amalfi revolt against the Normans
wars.outcome: Amalfi revolted in 1096 under its last doge Marinus Sebastus; the revolt was put down in 1101.

wars.name: Amalfi revolt and Roger II's reduction of the city
wars.outcome: Amalfi revolted in 1130; in 1131 Emir John marched by land while George of Antioch blockaded the town by sea from Capri, and Roger II subdued it.

certainty.note: The pages name the city and no boundary; the 96 km2 outline is Cliopatria's.
